Ivy Tran: Hi everyone 1st day and I'm stuck. I accepted the org invite but I only see public repos and cloning a private repo gives 404. The org page shows me as 'Outside collaborator'. Any ideas?
Marta Lopez: Hi Ivy, welcome! "Outside collaborator" usually means the invite was attached to a different account/email than the org expects. Did the invite go to your work email?
Ivy Tran: Yes invite went to ivy@redwood.ai. I accepted from my laptop which had my personal account logged in (ivy.codes). I must have clicked the invite while that session was active.
access-helper-bot: Automated note: Org enforces SAML SSO and 2FA. Users accepted on non-work accounts may appear as outside collaborators and will be blocked from private repos. Admins can revoke and reissue invites.
Marta Lopez: We can either add the SSH key to the account that accepted the invite (not ideal) or revoke the wrong acceptance and resend to the correct GH username. Which do you prefer?
Ivy Tran: I'd rather switch it to my work account. I don't want to mix keys. Please revoke and resend to ivy@redwood.ai.
Sam Miller: Revoke complete. Sent new invite to ivy@redwood.ai. When you accept, be sure you're signed into the correct GitHub user in the browser and click the SAML "Authorize" prompt if it appears.
Ivy Tran: New invite arrived, I accepted while explicitly signed into my work account (username ivy-tran). It prompted me to authorize SSO and I clicked authorize. The org page now shows "Member (SAML authorized)".
Ivy Tran: Trying to clone now over HTTPS yields 403. I think my local credential helper still has a cached token from my personal account.
Marta Lopez: Try clearing the stored credentials for github.com or switch to SSH. `git credential-osxkeychain erase` or remove entry from Windows credential manager. Or add your SSH key to ivy-tran and use an SSH URL.
Ivy Tran: Cleared credential helper and generated a new PAT on my work account with repo scope. Clone over HTTPS works now.
Sam Miller: Added Ivy to eng-platform and eng-runtime teams with write access. You should see team repos appear within a few minutes. Let us know if any perms still look off.
Ivy Tran: I can see team repos and pushed a tiny change. All good now, thanks!
thread_body_preview: Accepted invite on personal GH, appeared as outside collaborator; admin revoked and resent; accepted on work account and authorized SSO; old credential helper PAT caused 403, cleared and created work PAT; added to teams and push succeeded.
